description: §6.7.4 negative twin: an effect body that reads cells (listed or not), writes only a local, and calls a write-free function is NOT E-EFFECT-WRITES-STATE nor E-EFFECT-WRITE-UNPROVEN.
rationale: §6.7.4: "Reading an unlisted cell in the body is valid and is the dominant pattern"; "Writes to the body's own locals, and to plain non-reactive variables, are not reactive writes." A function with an empty write summary certifies. ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S447 "`when` → outside-world effects only, spelled `<effect>`" — "your recs, except expound 3b, specifically why the engine restriction."
